8:30 a.m. (ET) Friday, March 7, 2025
USDL-25-0200

THE EMPLOYMENT SITUATION -- FEBRUARY 2025

Total nonfarm payroll employment increased by 200,000 in February, and the unemployment rate was unchanged at 4.1 percent, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today.

The labor force participation rate, at 62.6 percent, was unchanged over the month.

In February, average hourly earnings for all employees on private nonfarm payrolls rose by 10 cents, or 0.3 percent, to $35.90. Over the past 12 months, average hourly earnings have increased by 3.9 percent.

The change in total nonfarm payroll employment for December was revised down by 5,000, from +256,000 to +251,000, and the change for January was revised down by 25,000, from +150,000 to +125,000. With these revisions, employment in December and January combined is 30,000 lower than previously reported.
